batches.title: Real pop segments vs evolved (rules) vs evolved (rules + corpus n-grams)
batches.notes: Blind test material. 'reference' = real TheoryTab transcriptions from the held-out test split, rendered from the annotations exactly like the evolved clips (same piano, same C major, 120 bpm). 'rules' = GA under hand-written rules only. 'corpus' = GA under rules + Hooktheory n-gram likelihood terms (melody 4-gram, chord 3-gram, chord-tone unigram).
